# Dr Abderrahim Zermane

Official website: https://azermane.com/

Dr Abderrahim Zermane is a fire and process safety researcher working across occupational accident prevention, fault tree analysis, explainable machine learning, hydrogen fire safety, physics-based urban fire modelling and evidence-led engineering systems.

## Author identity

- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=9ZkzMtcAAAAJ&hl=en
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5040-7704
- GitHub: https://github.com/AbderrahimZ1

## Flagship publications

1. Predicting fatal fall from heights accidents using random forest classification machine-learning model — Safety Science, 2023. https://azermane.com/paper-random-forest.html
2. Risk assessment of fatal accidents due to work-at-heights activities using fault tree analysis: Case study in Malaysia — Safety Science, 2022. https://azermane.com/paper-fault-tree.html
3. Linking Accident Data and Physics-Based Modeling for Hydrogen Fire Safety — Fire Technology, volume 62, issue 5, Article 128, 2026. https://azermane.com/paper-hydrogen-fire-safety.html
